comment: The reference video of format version 1 (FORMAT.md section 13): every later release must decode it to the file named, of the size and SHA-256 given, signed by the key given (the Ed25519 seed of bytes 0 to 31). The committed video is what is immutable; it was generated by the embedded engine with one worker from fixed inputs (go run ./tools/dev format-vectors), and a regeneration elsewhere need not give the same bytes.
